thread:
Mira: Dropped a micro-popover mock for first-run 1 : small centered popover that highlights "Create" in the header and lists 2 sample projects + a checklist. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/onboard/micro-popover :sparkles:
Josh: Cute and lightweight. Question: popover or toast? For keyboard users, popovers should be focus-trapped or else background inerted.
Mira: Intend popover to be ephemeral (show once) and not trap, so users can still explore. We could test trap-on-first-open.
Val: If non-trap, ensure main gets aria-hidden/inert when popover visible, otherwise SR reads behind it. Also add SR-only descriptions for project tiles.
Ana: CTA copy: current "Create project" -> feels formal. Short variants: "Try sample" or "Start sample". "Try sample" preferred for lower friction. Keep <20 chars for localization.
Priya: Localization note: German expands; avoid verbs that imply deploying. I18nBot: Add translator context: "sample = pre-built demo project with prompts and snippets."
Josh: Contrast: small-link secondary text at 12px fails contrast. Increase weight or use darker tone. Also ensure focus ring is visible.
Mira: UX question: show "Show again" in user menu after dismissal? I prefer ephemeral with explicit control in Help.
Val: Accessibility checklist: inert background, SR tile descriptions, focus return to header button, skip link, contrast 4.5:1. I'll run SR pass after updates.
Ana: I'll A/B test CTAs: ["Try sample","Start sample","Create project"]. Priya -> can you add analytics events: micro_popover_shown, sample_clicked?
Priya: Yup, will add events and a simple position tag.
Mira: Action items: Mira -> update figma with SR text and CTA variants. Josh -> prototype inert fallback. Val -> a11y pass. Ana -> test plan. Priya -> analytics. React :thumbsup: and I'll schedule a 15m micro-crit Mon.
